summary.text: Marla Smith is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 74, an office she has held since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A lifelong Pagedale resident, she worked for decades as a senior clerk in the St. Louis County 21st Circuit Court and served as a Pagedale alderperson from 2005 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Marla Smith graduated from Normandy High School.
Ballotpedia says her career included nearly 30 years as a senior clerk in the St. Louis County 21st Circuit Court, and that she served as an alderperson for the city of Pagedale from 2005 to 2017.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Pagedale resident born and raised in North St. Louis County, and as a mother and grandmother.
Smith assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Kevin Windham Jr.
She defeated Maria Miller in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Jack Howard in the general election.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Judiciary Committee, the Ethics Committee and the Local Government Committee.
In the same survey, Smith said her campaign centers on fully funded public schools, affordable healthcare, safer communities, workers' rights and respect for Missouri voters.
She named education and public safety as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
